notes.title: The demo for our new game, A Date with Death, is live now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=sEsdl0isP-o;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]The demo for A Date with Death is live now![/h1]

[h3]A Date with Death is our free to play romance chatsim where you enter a week long bet against the Grim Reaper to keep your soul! It features a character creator, room customisation, and the ability to flirt with (or bully) the Grim Reaper.[/h3]

[i]You're just an ordinary person... or so you thought. For your entire life, you've been narrowly avoiding death by pure luck... or is it something more? When a strange program suddenly appears on your computer, and someone claiming to be the Grim Reaper says he's come for your soul, your life as you know it is thrown upside down.

As you delve deeper into the mysterious man that calls himself the Grim Reaper, you begin to wonder if fate brought you two together for a reason. Can you resist his charm, or will you fall for the one destined to take your soul?
[/i]

💀 Custom Character Creation: Build your own protagonist, from their physical appearance to their pronouns and name. Update them throughout the game!
💀 Room Design: Decorate your apartment to your liking and create a cozy space that you'll love coming back to.
💀 Pet Your Furry (or scaley?) Companion: Yes, you can pet the dog. Snuggle up with your furry friend and let their cute antics help you unwind.
💀 Choices That Matter: Make decisions that will affect your character's fate and lead you to one of multiple possible endings. What kind of relationship will you have with the Grim Reaper?
💀 Gorgeous Original Art: Lose yourself in stunning visuals that bring the story to life, and feel like you're truly part of the world of A Date with Death.

notes.title: The Divine Speaker: The Sun and the Moon is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38316591/ea42033ecd50c1cdc456694f507665c802cfdbd9.png[/img]

[h1]The Divine Speaker: The Sun and the Moon is out NOW on Steam![/h1]

[i]Journey to the past with The Divine Speaker: The Sun and the Moon, an enthralling fantasy visual novel and 18+ prequel to the popular BL game, The Divine Speaker.

Follow the intertwining journeys of Lucius and Aemyl as they navigate their past and future, each grappling with the fate they have been dealt. Will they be able to find a happy future, or does only pain and suffering await them?

Lucius longs for a past that he cannot return to, while Aemyl is fixated on creating a future that may not come to pass. As their paths cross and their stories become intertwined, each must come to terms with the destiny that awaits them... or refuse to accept it.

In a game of the past and the future, the sun and the moon, who will come out on top?
[/i]

[previewyoutube=bxZWN25LkA8;full][/previewyoutube]

🌙 Immerse yourself in over 80,000 words of captivating fantasy storytelling, with dual storylines that are woven together to form a mesmerizing narrative that explores the depths of love, loss, and sacrifice. ​

☀️ Embark on a linear journey (no choices) that leads directly into the beginning of The Divine Speaker, the game that started it all.​

🌙 Feast your eyes on the stunning original artwork by Fuyuure, the original game's talented artist. ​

☀️ Explore 18+ scenes and artworks and the intimate relationships that come along with them.

🌙 Meet brand new characters... plus some returning ones!

notes.title: Fawn Route Voice Acting - OUT NOW
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It's finally the time everyone's been waiting for - the Fawn VA patch is now live on Steam!

Here's a quick list of changes:

[list]
[*] Fawn route audio implemented
[*] Audio adjusted in all other parts of the game
[*] Some CGs adjusted
[*] Settings adjusted
[*] Minor text inconsistencies adjusted
[/list]

We're finally at the point where the game is fully voiced! It's taken a long time, and along the way we've had many, MANY people assisting us with getting the voice acting complete.

This wouldn't have been doable without the help of our audio editor, Cats on a Lilypad Studios. Check them out on [url=https://twitter.com/CatsLilypad]Twitter[/url] if you've enjoyed The Divine Speaker - I think their games will be right up your alley.

A quick note: You may experience issues with your save files if they are within Fawn's route. We've made major changes to the line identifiers that make our voice acting work, so old saves can be unstable. If you have any problems with your saves, start a new game and skip through to where you were up to.

There we have it! As a final little plug, our new game Dreambound (BL mystery visual novel) has 12 hours left [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gabmag/dreambound?ref=2u5kjl]on Kickstarter[/url]! If you like BL, pretty art and a (hopefully!!!) interesting story, then check it out here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38316591/affe12845bf5b8e7d9c99445f3d45c6ff1fc3153.png[/img]

We also have one opportunity left to create a character that will be in our next The Divine Speaker game (a sequel that follows Nox and Soren!).

That's all for now! 
I really hope you enjoy The Divine Speaker!

Gabby, Lead Developer
Two and a Half Studios

notes.title: Fawn Voice Acting Route & Bug Fixes & Fundraising Campaign
notes.content:
Hello gamers!

Gabby here with a quick update on the Fawn route voice acting patch!

First of all, I hope you've all been enjoying the Leos route. Did you know that the game has over 15,000 voice files? Our poor audio editor can probably recite them all by heart...

Anywho, onto the update!


[h2]Fawn Route VA[/h2]

All voice lines for Fawn's route have been cut, edited, and inserted into the game. We're awaiting three actors sending in a few lines that needed either redoing or were missed in the initial recordings. We're hoping this won't take too long to receive.

Our audio editor is handling communication with the actors, editing and insertion of these extra lines, so at the moment we're hands off of The Divine Speaker while these last few audio related tasks are completed. 


[h2]Bug Fixes & Other Updates[/h2]
The latest build of The Divine Speaker includes a few bug fixes - mainly audio related, as well as a few extra CGs. We're planning to add one final one to the final release as a thank you for your patience.

[h2]Fundraising Campaign[/h2]

[previewyoutube=E_lrj_RREGY;full][/previewyoutube]

We're currently running a Kickstarter for our next BL project, Dreambound!

Dreambound is the story of a reclusive painter named Noah with the ability to enter dreams, and a series of murders (of people he used to know). It's a gorgeous, moody BL game that fans of TDS are sure to enjoy.

We have 13 days left on the campaign and we're currently 94% funded. We're so close! If it's within your means, even $5 goes a long way into continuing our game development journey.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gabmag/dreambound?ref=c01if6]Click here to check it out![/url]
